description:
# xmagnet — The growth engine Claude can actually run

Stop describing what you want done. Tell Claude — and watch it happen.

35 tools that turn one-line prompts into real revenue actions: prospect,
enrich, score, deal-make, run campaigns, refine ICP, analyze pipeline —
without ever leaving the chat.

## 🚀 Install in 60 seconds

**→ [api.xmagnet.ai/claude](https://api.xmagnet.ai/claude)**

Sign in with Google. Sample workspace spins up instantly — contacts, deals,
campaigns, ICP, all live. Every tool works end-to-end on first message.

**Free tier exposes all 35 tools. No 2FA. No card. No setup.**

## What you can ask Claude to do

**Find & enrich people**
- "Find C-suite at fintechs that raised Series A in the last 6 months"
- "Enrich john@acme.com and tell me who else there is worth pitching"
- "Validate these 200 emails before I send"

**Move deals forward**
- "Scan my open pipeline for buying intent — sort by urgency"
- "Show ghost deals stuck >14 days and draft re-engagement notes"
- "Create a $50k deal for Acme, assign to me, close target next month"

**Run outbound on autopilot**
- "Build a 4-step sequence for VPs of Sales at Series-B SaaS"
- "Generate a re-engagement campaign for openers who never replied"
- "Why are open rates down this week vs last month?"

**Capture & convert**
- "Generate a landing page for my Q2 webinar with a registration form"
- "Refine my ICP based on the last 50 deals I closed"
- "Find competitors of HubSpot and tell me who's hiring AEs"

## Built for

Founders, SDRs, RevOps, growth teams. Anyone who'd rather ship a sequence
in two sentences than click through five screens.

---

[Install →](https://api.xmagnet.ai/claude) · [Site](https://xmagnet.ai) · [Privacy](https://xmagnet.ai/privacy-policy) · [Terms](https://xmagnet.ai/terms-of-service) · Support: support@xmagnet.ai
